issue.title: ingest: Default index pipeline not being applied to docs during bulk indexing

repository.name: elasticsearch

issue.body:
**Elasticsearch version** (`bin/elasticsearch --version`): 6.5.1

**Description of the problem including expected versus actual behavior**: I am indexing a Google spreadsheet (using the add-on: https://github.com/elastic/google-sheets-add-on) into a 6.5.1 cluster. The index has a default pipeline defined, which works as expected if I use `_bulk` from within Console. But the pipeline is not being applied to docs indexed using a `_bulk` insert from the JavaScript code.

issue.title: ingest: support default pipelines + bulk upserts

labels.name: :Distributed/Ingest Node
labels.description: Execution or management of Ingest Pipelines

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
This commit adds support to enable bulk upserts to use an index's
default pipeline. Bulk upsert, doc_as_upsert, and script_as_upsert
are all supported.

However, bulk script_as_upsert has slightly surprising behavior since
the pipeline is executed _before_ the script is evaluated. This means
that the pipeline only has access the data found in the upsert field
of the script_as_upsert. The non-bulk script_as_upsert (existing behavior)
runs the pipeline _after_ the script is executed. This commit
does _not_ attempt to consolidate the bulk and non-bulk behavior for
script_as_upsert.

This commit also adds additional testing for the non-bulk behavior,
which remains unchanged with this commit.

fixes #36219

**Elasticsearch version** (`bin/elasticsearch --version`): `7.12.0` and lower.

[Docker-compose setup is used including elasticsearch and kibana docker images](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elastic-stack-get-started/7.12/get-started-docker.html)


**Description of the problem including expected versus actual behavior**:
*Expected behavior:*
`final_pipeline` executed on any operation (either update or upsert) when "update" action is used as part of the `_bulk` request 

*Actual behavior:*
`_bulk` API with `update` actions ignores execution of the `final_pipeline` in 2 cases:
* when `index` does not exist, but `final_pipeline` configured in index template with matching `index_pattern` and `"upsert"` executed (document with specified ID **does not exist**)
* when `index` exists, and `update action` is executed (document with specified ID **exists**)

This issue is **really** similar to #36219 , but a bit different.

**Steps to reproduce**:

**Case 1:** index dynamically created on `_bulk` request
```
DELETE test_index
PUT _ingest/pipeline/test_pipeline
{
    "processors" : [
      {
        "set": {
          "field": "ran_pipeline",
          "value": true
        }
      }
    ]
}

PUT _index_template/test_index_template
{
  "index_patterns": ["test_*"],
  "template": {
    "settings": {
      "index": {
        "final_pipeline": "test_pipeline"
      }
    }
  }
}

POST _bulk
{ "update": { "_index": "test_index", "_id": 1 } }
{ "doc": { "ran_update": true }, "upsert": { "run_upsert": true } }

GET test_index/_search
```

"upsert" is executed, the index dynamically created, but the `final_pipeline` ignored, result of the search request is:

```
"hits" : [
      {
        "_index" : "test_index",
        "_type" : "_doc",
        "_id" : "1",
        "_score" : 1.0,
        "_source" : {
          "run_upsert" : true
        }
      }
    ]
```
------------

**Case 2.** Index exists, "update" action is executed:

```
DELETE test_index
PUT _ingest/pipeline/test_pipeline
{
    "processors" : [
      {
        "set": {
          "field": "ran_pipeline",
          "value": true
        }
      }
    ]
}

PUT _index_template/test_index_template
{
  "index_patterns": ["test_*"],
  "template": {
    "settings": {
      "index": {
        "final_pipeline": "test_pipeline"
      }
    }
  }
}

# on the first request "upsert" is executed (case 1), so "ran_pipeline" is not set
POST _bulk
{ "update": { "_index": "test_index", "_id": 1 } }
{ "doc": { "ran_update": true }, "upsert": { "run_upsert": true } }

# now the document exists, so it will be updated with fields from "doc"
POST _bulk
{ "update": { "_index": "test_index", "_id": 1 } }
{ "doc": { "ran_update": true }, "upsert": { "run_upsert": true } }

GET test_index/_search
```

update action is executed, but the `final_pipeline` ignored, result of the search request is:
```
    "hits" : [
      {
        "_index" : "test_index",
        "_type" : "_doc",
        "_id" : "1",
        "_score" : 1.0,
        "_source" : {
          "ran_update" : true,
          "run_upsert" : true
        }
      }
    ]
```
---

**Comments:**
This is super similar to #36219, but that issue covers **the third** case, when "upsert" is executed when **index exists**

<details>
  <summary>Comparison to standalone `_update` requests</summary>
  
**Case 1**
```
DELETE test_index
PUT _ingest/pipeline/test_pipeline
{
    "processors" : [
      {
        "set": {
          "field": "ran_pipeline",
          "value": true
        }
      }
    ]
}

PUT _index_template/test_index_template
{
  "index_patterns": ["test_*"],
  "template": {
    "settings": {
      "index": {
        "final_pipeline": "test_pipeline"
      }
    }
  }
}

POST test_index/_update/1
{
  "doc": {
    "ran_doc_as_separate": true
  },
  "upsert": {
    "ran_upsert_as_separate": true
  }
}

GET test_index/_search
```
  
Result is 
```
"hits" : [
      {
        "_index" : "test_index",
        "_type" : "_doc",
        "_id" : "1",
        "_score" : 1.0,
        "_source" : {
          "ran_pipeline" : true,
          "ran_upsert_as_separate" : true
        }
      }
    ]
```


**Case 2**
```
DELETE test_index
PUT _ingest/pipeline/test_pipeline
{
    "processors" : [
      {
        "set": {
          "field": "ran_pipeline",
          "value": true
        }
      }
    ]
}

PUT _index_template/test_index_template
{
  "index_patterns": ["test_*"],
  "template": {
    "settings": {
      "index": {
        "final_pipeline": "test_pipeline"
      }
    }
  }
}

# Create document without "ran_pipeline" field
POST _bulk
{ "update": { "_index": "test_index", "_id": 1 } }
{ "doc": { "ran_doc": true }, "upsert": { "run_upsert": true } }


GET test_index/_search

POST test_index/_update/1
{
  "doc": {
    "ran_doc_as_separate": true
  },
  "upsert": {
    "ran_upsert_as_separate": true
  }
}

GET test_index/_search
```

Result is

```
"hits" : [
      {
        "_index" : "test_index",
        "_type" : "_doc",
        "_id" : "1",
        "_score" : 1.0,
        "_source" : {
          "run_upsert" : true,
          "ran_doc_as_separate" : true,
          "ran_pipeline" : true
        }
      }
    ]
```
</details>
